body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-04-30 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "Cash flow and working capital are expected to improve considerably going forward, considering the quality of order intake this year." Metric: Working-capital days / debtor days / CFO. Target: further improvement on FY25 (debtor days 55, WC days 28 per screener). Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: vague; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: Cash flow improved: CFO INR 153 -> 277 cr; CFO/EBITDA 42% -> 56% (screener). Working capital worsened: trade receivables INR 701 -> 1,485 cr (2.1x on +20% revenue); debtor days 55 -> 98; WC days 28 -> 43 (screener). Company-defined NWC days were 62 (Sep-24) and 88 (Dec-24); in Oct-26 the target became '90-100 days stable'. FCF still -88 cr; cash 121 -> 32 cr. Explanation given: Apr-26, only when asked: INR 260 cr arrived 1-2 April ('technical reason'); Q4 domestic revenue +45% with slower domestic collections; GST on billing
